description: Daily proactive status card. Sourced from ALL THREE monitors - the 2026-08-13 card said '9/9 healthy' from the snapshot probe alone while a camera stood 185h past its motion-staleness window on the same panel. 'Probes OK' is the honest claim: the probe measures the snapshot path, not motion-event delivery. 2026-08-30: now sourced from ALL FOUR monitors (cam_vision was missing entirely, and it is the one with no dead-man). Each line carries its own NOT REPORTING fallback. The motion guard used to test stale_count is none, but cam_motion.py's fail() path leaves stale_count at 0, so a monitor that had just failed rendered as the affirmative all-clear "0 camera(s) beyond their staleness window"; it now tests error and hours_since, which do go null on that path. A BOOT TRIGGER was added because a bare 08:00 time trigger means any restart after 08:00 erases the only proactive positive signal for the rest of the day, and its absence is indistinguishable from a healthy fleet - it went silently missing on 3 of the 7 days to 2026-08-30.

data.title: 📷 Camera health
